neurovascular_unit.project_use: Turns 'House wall' into a living distributed boundary instead of a passive shell.

barrier_ecology.distinction: tight endothelial barrier supported by neurovascular-unit interactions
separate epithelial barrier governing blood↔ventricular CSF exchange
modified vascular permeability enables sensing/secretion; not generic BBB failure
separate border compartments with immune/vascular functions

vascular_gradient.principle: Arterial, capillary and venous endothelial/perivascular states form spatial and molecular gradients rather than one generic blood-vessel cell type.
vascular_gradient.development: Brain vascular growth is dynamic during development, relatively quiescent in healthy adult tissue and can reactivate/remodel in disease.
vascular_gradient.integration: Supply roads must therefore be modeled as cellular territories plus flow networks, not pipes alone.

glial_truths: Neural computation depends on non-neuronal cells for metabolic, ionic, immune and structural homeostasis.
White matter is a living axon–oligodendrocyte–astrocyte–vascular system rather than inert cabling.
Barrier physiology is distributed across specialized interfaces; BBB and blood-CSF barrier are not interchangeable.
Cell state changes with development, region, aging, injury and disease, so fixed cartoon cell types are incomplete.
